rejected.title: Hatshepsut
card: Hatshepsut was a woman who ruled Egypt for about 20 years in the 1400s BCE. She first ruled for her young stepson, Thutmose III, and some years later took the title of pharaoh herself.
She sent a trading expedition by ship to the land of Punt, reached by sailing south along the Red Sea. It brought back goods such as incense, myrrh trees, ebony and gold.
She built a great temple at Deir el-Bahari, near Thebes. Its terraces were built against a cliff on the west bank of the Nile.
Her reign was mainly a time of trade and building, though there were some military campaigns. Her temple and its carved scenes of the Punt voyage still survive as evidence of what she did.
rejected.remember: Hatshepsut was a female pharaoh remembered mainly for trade with Punt and her temple at Deir el-Bahari.

a.q: Which of these was an achievement of Hatshepsut's reign?
opts: She sent a trading expedition to Punt
She signed a peace treaty with the Hittites
She built the Great Pyramid at Giza
She led Egypt's army at the Battle of Kadesh
a.why: Hatshepsut sent ships to Punt, and they brought back goods such as incense and ebony. The Hittite treaty came after the Battle of Kadesh, which was fought under Ramesses II, so it was not her achievement.
a.clue: Think about what the carvings at her temple show.

b.q: Mia visits Deir el-Bahari near Thebes and sees a large temple with terraces against a cliff. Carved scenes show ships returning with trees and incense. Which ruler's reign do they tell us about?
opts: Hatshepsut, who ruled Egypt for about 20 years
Ramesses II, who signed a treaty with the Hittites
Thutmose III, who ordered the voyage to Punt
Hatshepsut, who ruled Egypt for more than 60 years
b.why: The temple at Deir el-Bahari and the voyage to Punt both belong to Hatshepsut, who ruled for about 20 years. The option saying she ruled for more than 60 years has the right ruler but the wrong length of reign, so it does not fit.
b.clue: Match the temple and the voyage to one ruler, then check how long she ruled.
